validation.initialLint: Private ignored capture scripts were included by ESLint; excluded for successful check

restoration.playback: Original 1x playback restored; frame advances during verification

mapRateCorrection.reason: Historical reports include zero-count statistics from all three display windows; current reports omit windows that never exercise Map. Raw reported rates are not comparable.
mapRateCorrection.denominator: Elapsed analysis-window seconds for the one window that actually records map draws

cpuTriage.attribution: Process attribution only; same-host historical-source and runtime controls remain necessary.

reviewAudit.status: Same-session source controls did not reproduce an aggregate CPU/FPS regression. Historical cross-date drift, presentation cost, private growth, limited widget coverage and the rare overlay stall remain distinct findings. Neither canvas variant is retained.
reviewAudit.foregroundScope: iRacing was activated before capture and checked periodically through the UI. These point observations and the absence of other automated UI inputs support the intended foreground protocol; continuous OS foreground state was not recorded.

reportingCorrections: Unavailable Gantry renderer timings are null rather than zero.
Historical renderer-rate corrections are annotated beside original values.
The cross-report CPU evidence fingerprint is refreshed after appended follow-ups.

definitions.rendererP99Mean: Main analyzer: frame-count-weighted mean of per-report p99 values, not a pooled frame percentile. Individual-widget audit table: arithmetic mean of per-report p99 values. PresentMon distributions use the selected individual frame intervals.
definitions.memoryCorrelation: Pearson r over timestamp/private-memory points in the stated analysis window; descriptive short-window association, not a long-running leak diagnosis.
definitions.runtimeSource: The 1592 archived src files match a5200766 after CRLF normalization. Recorded runtime/native binary fingerprints are retained; this is not a byte-reproducible rebuild of a historical released installer.

reviewAudit.publicationScope: Aggregate evidence and fingerprints only. Private profile/history files, raw SDK session data, CSVs and large traces remain outside the commit; independent reproduction of historical numbers requires those original local artifacts.
